TEXT:
After touring the Studio Park, we didn't have 
anywhere else we wanted to go.
Eventually, we decided to visit the Gion Machiya.

...In the meantime, my point card's filling up with 
stamps.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Nmph... All this walking sure gets tiring. Don't you 
agree, Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah... Where should we go next?

We had tea and anmitsu at a rest stand nearby 
while we discussed our next destination.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Hmm, it's getting dark now, so we probably 
shouldn't go anywhere too far.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I think we've gone pretty far already.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Yeah, you're right. I mean, we're on a vacation, 
after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, I feel like we can just take it easy. Is there 
anywhere you'd like to visit, Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I'm satisfied at this point. I would like to stop over 
some souvenir shops, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'd like to pick something up myself too. Let's finish 
this up before going.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, just a moment.

I noticed some brown sugar syrup on the corner of 
Manami's mouth.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hold still.

I take out my handkerchief and wipe the syrup 
away.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Nn... Thanks, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Okay, let me just stamp your card.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey now, if you're just going to give it out like that, 
one card won't be enough.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hehe, that might be true.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Thank you for your patronage.①

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That again... You don't have to say that every time, 
you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I know but... I'm just so grateful for each little thing 
you do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Oh, okay.

Taking the card back, I notice there's only one 
space left.

Also, tonight is the last night of our trip. I'll have to 
give it all I got and seize this last opportunity!

I pledge to myself, I'll fill up the point card and 
make the night count!
